row.evidence: Balsamiq's pricing page lists 'SSO with SAML' only on Enterprise ($35/month/editor, billed annually) and no SCIM on any plan; the SAML help article lists IdP-initiated SSO and JIT provisioning as the Okta integration's only provisioning feature.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). Pricing changed since June: Balsamiq Cloud is now priced per editor (Starter $16, Teams $24, Enterprise $35 per editor per month, billed annually; reviewers free) instead of project-count plans, so June's 'Business: $12/mo' and 'Enterprise $18/mo+' are replaced. SAML SSO (Enterprise) creates users just-in-time as Staff Reviewers; removal is manual. No SCIM endpoint or user-management API found in the pricing page, the 755-URL sitemap, the help centre or the MCP integration docs. Okta's OIN Balsamiq app is SAML only. SAML setup guides exist for Google and Entra ID as custom SAML apps (no gallery listing found).

scim.notes: Not documented anywhere searched; recorded as none by absence.

limitations.text: The only programmatic interface documented is the MCP server for reading and editing designs from AI tools, not user administration.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SAML as checked (read from page markup); Balsamiq lists JIT as the only provisioning feature.

entra.notes: Balsamiq documents Entra ID SAML setup; learn.microsoft.com balsamiq-tutorial returns 404, so no gallery app found.

google.notes: SAML setup guidance only; provisioning not mentioned.

open_questions: Balsamiq never says 'no SCIM' explicitly; status is none by absence.
Whether SAML JIT users are removed or kept when deprovisioned in the IdP is not documented.
No public REST/admin API for users found; Balsamiq for Confluence and Jira (Atlassian apps) were not researched.
